items.title: Email forwarding
items.html:
As a member of the USI Alumni community you can benefit from a free lifelong e-mail forwarding service through the new account name.lastname@alumni.usi.ch

This service permanently forwards all e-mails to the address of your choice (personal or professional). It will thus allow you to keep an USI address, even if you change your email address, with advantages such as to receive from USI only Alumni related emails and to be always identified as an USI graduate.

Activate the USI Alumni email

To change your forwarding address linked to name.lastname@alumni.usi.ch, please access your personal alumni page (with NET ID and password already assigned to you. Have you forgotten them? Contact us: alumni@usi.ch).
In the personal alumni page you may change the forward destination address.

items.title: Long Life Learning, scholarships and incentives
items.html:
USI offers its graduates several executive programs (CAS, DAS and MAS) and MOOCs (Massive Open Online Course) in highly specialised fields, internationally-oriented and designed to meet the needs of experienced professionals in an increasingly globalised society.

We remind you that as an USI alumnus/a you can benefit from scholarships and study incentives to attend courses at USI.

items.title: Career Services
items.html:
The Alumni Service offers to fresh graduates (until 1 year after graduation) a support in job search:

  • Job Bank
  • Career Newsletter
  • Useful links for your career

items.title: Library
items.html:
USI Alumni can continue to benefit from USI library services for free or on favorable terms.

  • Interlibrary Loan Regulations and document delivery

The Interlibrary Loan provides access to material not available in our Library’s collections. Requests are forwarded to libraries in Switzerland and abroad. It is also possible to request copies of articles in periodicals that are not available in our collections.

USI graduates can apply for the following rates:

Document location Fees for USI Alumni
Books Articles
Ticino (SBT) Free Free
Switzerland (RERO and IDS) Free CHF 10.- up to 20 pg.
Others Actual expenses Actual expenses
  • On-site consultation

On-site consultation is granted up to 3 years from graduation.
